# Abhishek Chatterjee — Serverless Engineer | React Developer | Event-Driven

> I'm a Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience building production systems in fintech. I started as a Frontend Developer crafting React interfaces, and today I work as a Serverless Engineer, designing event-driven, cloud-native backends on AWS — Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions, and the wider serverless ecosystem.
> My work spans the full stack: streaming APIs, durable cross-account workflows, content architecture with Sanity CMS, and the CI/CD pipelines that ship it all.

Experience: 2+ years. Location: India. Highlights: 2+ Years Experience, Serverless Engineer, Linux Enthusiast, Open Source Lover. Interests: Custom PC Assembly, Open Source, Linux.

## Projects
### Face Auth System
Face-recognition authentication platform. Iterated from browser-side detection (face-api.js, MediaPipe) to an AWS Rekognition compareFaces backend, with a production admin dashboard.
- Tech: face-api.js, MediaPipe, AWS Rekognition, React, Express

### Fire Calculator (showcase)
The fire calculator is a calculator that will return the yearly expenses (as of Today), year expenses (as of Retirement) and the fire number is the amount that you need to become financially independent.
- Tech: React, React-Reducer, CSS
- Features: Calculate FIRE number; Retirement planning
- Code: https://github.com/abhishek1337chatterjee/Fire-Calculator
- Live: https://fire-calculator-zeta.vercel.app/

### Freshly Website (showcase)
Freshly delivers gourmet ready-made meals, prepared and delivered at the door. It is dedicated to making healthy eating and achieving health and fitness goals easier than ever.
- Tech: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
- Features: Login/Signup using local storage; Filtering Sorting; Adding items to chart
- Scope: team of 5, 5 days
- Code: https://github.com/abhishek1337chatterjee/freshly.com
- Live: https://fluffy-croquembouche-14d5f2.netlify.app/

### Glance Dashboard (personal)
Self-hosted personal dashboard with custom Node.js microservices — GitHub security advisories, kernel.org LTS tracking, and a system-stats panel (power monitoring, disk health, network stats). Deployed via Docker Compose with health checks and auto-start.
- Tech: Node.js 24, Express.js 5, Docker, Docker Compose, GraphQL, REST APIs, RSS/Atom, SQLite, Chart.js, smartmontools , vnstat
- Features: GitHub Security Advisory feeds via GraphQL; Kernel.org LTS release tracking; Movie/OTT streaming feeds (TMDb + OMDb); 15+ RSS endpoints across services; 30-60 min in-memory caching; Health checks with dependency chain; System Stats dashboard with power monitoring; Power history with 2-year SQLite persistence; Energy consumption tracking (kWh daily/monthly); Disk health monitoring (SMART + SD card); Network stats via vnstat with graphs; Docker container stats with live updates
- Live: https://glance-dashboard-u99g.onrender.com

### Jet Prints (experience) [discontinued]
Advanced eCommerce platform for custom printing on products like mugs and business cards. Integrated PDF upload and payment processing.
- Tech: React, Redux, TypeScript, Express.js, Node.js, Canvas API
- Features: Custom product design; PDF upload; Payment processing; Canvas-based editor

### Pear Website (showcase)
Pear is built with the reference website apple.com. A sleek product showcase website.
- Tech: React, Redux, Axios, React-Router-Dom, Firebase-Auth, Chakra-UI, Vitejs
- Features: Login/Signup; Google Authentication; Admin Section; Cart; Place Order
- Scope: team of 5, 5 days
- Code: https://github.com/abhishek1337chatterjee/Pear-website
- Live: https://pear-website.netlify.app/

### Pulse
Two local analytics CLIs — claude-stats (where my Claude Code spend goes: cost by model, cache hit-rate, top tools / skills / subagents) and battery-stats (real screen-on-time, drain rate, battery health). DuckDB on disk, self-contained HTML dashboards, no cloud or telemetry.
- Tech: Fish, DuckDB, HTML, JavaScript
- Code: https://github.com/abhishek1337chatterjee/pulse

### QuoteCheck
PDF rental-quote matching platform built on the builder.ai Bx scaffold. OCR-parses vendor rate sheets and matches line items against client rate cards, with a document library, bulk upload, keyword highlighting, and an analytics console.
- Tech: React Native, React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, react-pdf, Material UI

### Wearly Website (showcase)
Wearly is a full-stack online fashion and cosmetic retailer. The project was built in 5 days as a collaborative effort.
- Tech: React, Redux, React Router, Chakra UI, Node.js, Express, MongoDB
- Features: Login/Signup; Google Authentication; Admin Section; Cart; Place Order
- Scope: team of 5, 5 days
- Code: https://github.com/abhishek1337chatterjee/Wearly-Website
- Live: https://wearly.vercel.app/

## Case studies (time.money)
### Cross-Account Account-Deletion Saga [flagship]
Durable orchestration erasing a user across 3 AWS accounts — cancellable, auditable, provable.
- Role: architect & sole implementer · Timeline: Mar 2026 → Aug 2026 · Domains: durable-execution, cross-account, compliance
- Stack: Durable Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, Cognito, EventBridge, cross-account IAM
- Callback-proxy pattern so durable workflows receive cross-account completion signals
- Two-phase deletion: grace window, transactional cancel, then irreversible execution with lockout
- Audit-grade trail — per-service records, S3 archive, forensic runbook

### Multi-Agent AI Platform [flagship]
Bedrock AgentCore orchestrator + domain specialists — streaming chat, guardrails, PII-masked observability.
- Role: built end-to-end — infra, agents, frontend · Timeline: Feb 2026 → now · Domains: genai, agentcore, streaming
- Stack: Bedrock AgentCore, MCP, OpenTofu, Next.js SSE, Cognito, CloudWatch
- Orchestrator routes each message to domain specialist agents over an MCP gateway
- AI-generated session titles streamed mid-response; deterministic status events for the UI
- Guardrails with per-agent denied topics and PII masking on runtime logs

### Regulated Financial Data Pipelines
Credit-bureau + Account Aggregator ingestion, consent-gated end to end.
- Role: sole backend owner · Timeline: Nov 2024 → now · Domains: event-driven, consent, aa-india
- Stack: AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge Scheduler, SQS, S3, AppConfig
- Event-driven bureau ingestion with EventBridge fan-out to downstream consumers
- OTP consent lifecycle: grant, expiry countdown, revocation with correct event ordering
- Consent-driven scheduling — schedules created and destroyed by consent state

### Assessment & Scoring Platform
Three scoring engines driven by one CMS content brain — zero-deploy question iteration.
- Role: built all three engines + content schemas · Timeline: Oct 2024 → now · Domains: sanity-cms, scoring, i18n
- Stack: AWS Lambda, Sanity CMS, GROQ, DynamoDB, EventBridge, Cognito JWT
- Risk, behaviour, and wealth engines sharing one pattern: CMS questions → events → scored reports
- Draft/published content perspectives — product iterates questions with zero deploys
- Identity from verified Cognito JWTs, never the client; cross-assessment gates via claims

### User Lifecycle & Payments Platform
Event-driven email, nudges, onboarding state — exactly-once payments, token entitlements.
- Role: sole owner of every service in the group · Timeline: Feb 2025 → now · Domains: ses-v2, idempotency, entitlements
- Stack: AWS Lambda, EventBridge, SQS/DLQ, SES v2, React Email, Cognito triggers
- Exactly-once notification semantics on an at-least-once webhook pipeline
- Onboarding state machine — single source of truth with optimistic locking
- Coupon/trial system designed and shipped in a week to unblock a payment-provider limitation

### Platform Engineering & DX
Fleet template ownership — SAM, Biome, ESM migrations rippled through 30+ services.
- Role: de-facto owner of fleet conventions · Timeline: Dec 2024 → now · Domains: aws-sam, templates, tooling
- Stack: AWS SAM, esbuild, Biome, GitHub Actions, SonarQube, TypeScript
- Owned the fleet-standard Lambda template from its first commit
- Drove Serverless→SAM, Biome, and ESM migrations across 30+ services
- Internal CLIs: cross-account deletion verifier, quality dashboard, vendor mock platform
